prediction_exposure_at_registration: Prior development and historical result summaries are known; no new G2 model predictions inspected in this work order
question_set: Frozen G2 94 IDs, two questions per 47 SEC accessions; no in-place question edits
financial_cell_requirements: fiscal period and duration or instant
comparative_rule: The requested current and one immediately prior comparable period are mandatory unless the frozen wording explicitly enumerates more. Further prior years are supplemental; 3M and 6M or 9M may not substitute for each other. Balance sheets use INSTANT, flow statements use DURATION.
negative_rule: NEGATIVE_SUPPORTED_BOUNDED requires examination of the complete relevant statement or bounded filing section; absence from keyword search is insufficient.
equivalence_rule: Cost of revenue versus cost of sales and other accounting synonyms require explicit declared scope and human policy for strict gold; numerical agreement alone does not resolve wording.
exclusion_rule: Frozen questions remain unchanged. Prospective exclusions and wording errata are separately versioned overlays with affected IDs, reason and denominator impact. Ambiguous or partial questions are not silently scored exact.
overlap_disclosure: Eight potential source-cell overlap rows affect six unique question IDs; exact question wording is unseen in those rows but cell/document/issuer-unseen claims are not universal.
qrel_rule: Only one original frozen returned chunk can earn original single-chunk retrieval credit (F10 Policy B). Source HTML or stitched chunks validate source truth only. Missing or unpooled chunks remain UNJUDGED, never negative.
pool_rule: Single prospective pool from six author arms and frozen FAITH-R arms at identical depth 20; union deduplicated by original chunk ID. No repeated expansion after viewing held-out scores; pool construction is evaluation-stage exposure.
metrics: judged-only graded nDCG@10 with coverage and sensitivity bounds
metric_limits: No corpus-exhaustive Recall/MRR/nDCG from incomplete qrels. Report judged fraction and optimistic/pessimistic bounds; do not coerce UNJUDGED to NONE.
comparison: Paired by frozen question; bootstrap 95% confidence interval clustered by filing accession (47 clusters), issuer-cluster sensitivity (10 clusters), fixed seed 20261103 and 10000 replicates; report small-n limits.

tiers.AI_PROVISIONAL: requires source-first AI dispositions and eligible assessed qrels; labelled provisional
tiers.HUMAN_CERTIFIED: requires genuine human approval, question/erratum signoff, assessed qrels and separate final-run authorization

change_control: Any substantive change creates v2 with reason, prior protocol SHA-256, affected IDs, model-output exposure disclosure and independence downgrade. Never edit v1 in place after lock.
